{"assessments":[{"index":0,"entryId":"CD010753","conditionMatch":true,"treatmentMatch":true,"grade":4,"topicGrade":4,"quote":"Nocturnal melatonin secretion and polysomnographic sleep patterns were investigated in ten patients with chronic primary insomnia ... after either a single intravenous administration of 25 mg doxepin or placebo ...
